picks.name: Unusual Whales
picks.text:
BREAKING: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick repeatedly held up restrictions on Nvidia $NVDA chip exports to China, even after Trump approved them three times, per Axios.

At an Oval Office meeting, Trump asked Elon Musk for his view; Musk backed tighter controls, along with Rubio, Bessent and Hegseth. Lutnick warned the move “will start a trade war with China.” Trump ordered: “Let’s get it done.”

The restrictions still haven’t been put in place,
picks.why: Commerce Secretary Lutnick delayed Nvidia chip export restrictions to China despite Trump orders

picks.name: Unusual Whales
picks.text:
BREAKING: Senator Josh Hawley has endorsed a temporary pause on data center construction, becoming the highest-ranking Republican to back a nationwide moratorium.

“Senator Hawley is calling for a federal data center moratorium until Congress passes a bill of rights giving taxpayers guarantees of no rate increases,” a Hawley spokesperson said.
picks.why: Senator Hawley endorses a federal data center construction moratorium, threatening utility and AI infrastructure

picks.name: Unusual Whales
picks.text:
Microsoft , $MSFT, says it will “pay our own way” to power its data centers, without government subsidies or pushing up electricity costs for other customers, per Bloomberg.

“We don’t want other customers to be paying for our growth,” said Noelle Walsh, president of Microsoft’s cloud operations.

Microsoft is spending about $117 billion this year on AI and cloud data centers, and says it will keep building.
picks.why: Microsoft commits to funding its own data center power without government subsidies or raising consumer rates
